card.name: Dosing interval wording before hour counts
card.fires_on: The word "every" or "q" (or the space after it) right after a dose amount, just before the number of hours. It also fires on a closing bracket before "one hour later".

modes.label: every / q after dose
modes.description: The word "every" or the letter "q" follows a dose in mg and comes before an hour interval.
modes.example: 500 mg every 6 hours OR 1000 mg<< every>> 8 hours OR 100

modes.label: space after every
modes.description: The blank after "every" just before the number of hours.
modes.example: 100 mg/m 2 IV every<< >>3 hours until the methotrexate

modes.label: timing after a dose
modes.description: A closing bracket after a dose, just before a time gap such as "one hour later".

card.writes: It pushes the model toward short time spans such as two days, first day, or two hours.
card.plain: It marks the spot after a dose where the next word gives how often or how soon to repeat it.
